name: Zhende Medical Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhende Medical Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of medical care and protective equipment in China and internationally. The company offers a gauze swab, lap sponge, and fluff gauze swab; non-woven swab; PBT bandage, elastic bandage, crepe bandage, crochet bandage, selvedge bandage, under-cast padding, and fluff gauze roll; dressing set; first aid kit; cotton pad and applicator; and gauze roll and abdominal pad.
